prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a small background wildlife animation asset for the EXACT woodland cottage environment in IMAGE 2. Image 2 is the PRIMARY ART STYLE authority: intricate textured tiny pixel clusters, warm daylight from upper left, moss greens and warm muted browns, softly integrated selective outlines. NOT the heavy black cartoon outlines of UI mascots. It should look painted by the SAME artist at the SAME pixel density as the roof, trees and flowers of image 2, not a sticker or foreground mascot.
Canvas 2048x2048. EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows, 512x512 equal cells. Pure solid magenta #FF00FF background; no grid lines or labels. A tiny natural red squirrel with modest head-to-body ratio sits on a narrow moss-covered bough emerging from foliage on the RIGHT; the bough is thin, not a freestanding large vertical tree trunk. Small cluster of leaves at right hides it on departure. This is a quiet distant environmental visitor. No thick ink outlines, no glossy anime eyes, no clothing, no acorn prop, no human hands, no UI.
Tree bough and leaves are identical and stationary in every cell: bough contact baseline Y=370, extends from X=70 to X=455; foliage at X=385..470, Y=120..370. Squirrel neutral feet X=240 Y=370, ears top Y=160, body height 210px, skull width 70px, torso length 115px. Across movement keep exact skull width/body proportions; no per-frame size adjustment. Bushy tail complete; minimum 40px safe margins. At runtime whole cell is only about 110px wide, squirrel body about 45px tall, so use fine environmental texture and subdued contrast.
16 genuinely distinct consecutive poses: 1-4 perched still, a tiny blink and nose turn; 5-8 gradually turns right and extends front paws to bough, no body jump; 9-12 climbs along the bough toward right foliage with alternating limb contacts, tail follows; 13-16 progressively disappears behind the right leaf cluster until completely hidden in frame16. Do not change branch scale or shift its position. The right leaf cluster naturally continues into the scene foliage. No abrupt teleport, no zoom. All cells equally framed, transparent-key margin preserved. Original artwork; match scene textures and light rather than copying a patch of its pixels. CRITICAL REVISION: the previous sheet clipped the foliage at the RIGHT edge of cells. Reduce the entire asset footprint including bough, foliage AND tail to the inner 65% of EACH cell. Every visible pixel must lie inside X=90..420, Y=90..420 in each 512px cell, leaving a CLEAR unbroken 90px transparent-key gutter between cells. Foliage must end BEFORE X=420, not extend out of the cell. Compose small and distant. Squirrel body height 140px, skull width 48px, foot baseline Y=350, standing foot center X=220. Thin bough ends at X=410; leaf cover X=335..410. Maintain absolute matching scale and placement in all sixteen cells. Render actual crisp square pixel clusters with fine painterly palette like IMAGE 2, NOT smooth rendered fur. Flat solid opaque magenta background, no partial transparency, no colored halos. Do NOT fill cells tightly. All leaves/branch complete inside every cell.

PRODUCTION CONSISTENCY CONTRACT (applies to every asset): Declare exact output canvas dimensions, equal cell dimensions when using a sprite grid, intended in-scene footprint, fixed projection/camera, light direction, pixel-cluster density and outline weight matching the scene reference. For animated subjects, lock the same model sheet across ALL actions: constant skull width, head-to-body ratio, torso length, costume seams, foot spacing and ground-contact baseline. First and last neutral poses must match the canonical idle geometry. Frame bounding boxes may grow only for moving limbs/props, NEVER enlarge or shrink the whole body to fill a cell. Use one common padded canvas; reserve at least 8 percent margins around the widest action, never crop ears/tail/furniture. No per-frame zoom, reframing, translation of a copied pose, squash/stretch, or automatic tight framing. Fixed props and furniture remain the same size and at the same anchors throughout. Define body height, head width, foot-center X and foot baseline Y numerically in each animation task. For scenes/UI/items, explicitly preserve aspect ratio, safe area, optical size, border thickness and reference pixel density across variants. Backgrounds fill all edges; UI nine-slice corners remain fixed; no baked-in labels or text. Inspect transition between idle and interaction, NOT just individual sheets. Size/anchor/style mismatch means reject and regenerate; a successful HTTP response is not visual approval.
